# devloop

> A test-driven development loop for agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, and other harnesses that support subagent delegation). It splits an agent's one-shot "done" into three gated commands and adds independent review agents that grade work in a context that did not write it.

devloop ships as plain markdown plus a bash validator: no runtime, no network calls, no service of its own. It runs inside the coding agent you already use and reads per-project context from a `.devloop/` folder (`config.md` for engineering, `domain.md` for domain knowledge).

## The loop

- **/spec**: clarify WHAT to build (user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases). Gate: an 8-point spec-validation checklist.
- **/plan**: decide HOW. Decompose the spec into ordered, dependency-aware chunks and write a JSON tracker that survives context resets. Gate: the `review-plan` agent, before any code is written.
- **/implement**: BUILD each chunk test-first (red then green) against the plan. Gate: the `review-impl` (conformance) and `red-team` (correctness) agents, run in parallel and read-only.

The loop is not one-way: if a review finding shows the plan itself was wrong, /implement appends corrective chunks and re-runs the plan gate in-session, so the plan and code converge.

## The review layer

- **review-impl** answers "does the code match the plan?" It marks each acceptance criterion CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED, each backed by a quoted test line.
- **red-team** answers "is the code wrong or wasteful?" It hunts bugs across five angles regardless of the plan, recall-biased first, then verifies each finding and drops false positives. Modes: bugs, cleanup, both. On a large diff the red-team half splits into parallel bug and cleanup passes; on a small one it stays a single pass. It can be invoked directly on any diff, with no tracker.

The point of the layer: the reviewer never wrote the code, so a pass comes with evidence instead of a self-report.

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add KashZod/devloop` then `/plugin install devloop@kashzod`
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add KashZod/devloop` then `codex plugin add devloop@kashzod`
